title: Race finish order
observableEvidence: Uses four interacting clues about relative order to determine a unique finishing order among four competitors, checking every clue against the final arrangement.
prompt: Four runners — Dee, Eli, Fay, and Gus — finished a race in some order with no ties. Eli finished immediately before Fay. Dee finished before Eli, but not first. Gus did not finish last. What was the finishing order, from 1st to 4th?
solutionRepresentation: Eli-immediately-before-Fay means they are adjacent as (Eli, Fay) in that order. Dee is before Eli but not first, so someone is before Dee; that must be Gus (the only remaining runner), giving Gus, Dee, Eli, Fay. Gus is not last, which is satisfied (Gus is 1st).
solutionMethod: First place the fixed adjacent pair (Eli immediately before Fay), then use 'Dee before Eli but not first' to require exactly one runner before Dee, and confirm Gus filling that slot satisfies the 'not last' clue.

deterministicValidator.equivalenceNotes: Accept the four names in finishing order, separated by commas, spaces, or numbered, or as choice B.

hintSteps.prompt: Two of the clues describe runners next to each other or relative to each other; find the pair that must stay glued together first.
hintSteps.question: Which two runners must be directly next to each other, and in what order?

hintSteps.prompt: Dee must be before Eli, but Dee cannot be first, so exactly one runner must come before Dee.
hintSteps.question: Which runner is left to fill the single spot before Dee?

hintSteps.prompt: Once you have a candidate order, check every single clue against it one at a time, the way you would double-check a completed sudoku row.
hintSteps.question: Using Gus in the open spot before Dee, what final order do you get, and does it satisfy all four clues?

review.originalityStatement: Original logic-puzzle scenario written for this repository, inspired only by the general Math Kangaroo skill type of multi-clue ordering deduction at contest difficulty; no problem reproduced from any contest archive.

accessibilityNotes: Present all four clues as a plain-text numbered list rather than relying on a diagram of the race.
accessibleAlternative: Read aloud or display: Four runners, Dee, Eli, Fay, and Gus, finished a race with no ties. Eli finished immediately before Fay. Dee finished before Eli, but not first. Gus did not finish last. Determine the finishing order from 1st to 4th.
